name: Jarl Needs Eyes
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Eye juice is good juice for drinking.  Too bad most critters only have two eyes.

But spiders have lots of eyes.  Lots and lots.  And Darkmist eye juice is tasty.  Smooth and salty!  Unpopped spider eyes... I taste them already.

Darkmist spiders are west of here, in the Darkmist Cavern.  You figure the spiders are named after the cave... or is it the other way around?
narrative.objectives: Bring 20 Unpopped Darkmist Eyes to "Swamp Eye" Jarl at the Swamplight Manor.
narrative.offerRewardText:
You got the eyes! You got the eyes! Tasty, tasty spider eyes!

Some eyes... when you stare at them they stare back. Eat those last. They keep you company... out in the swamp.

Hello, little spider eyes. Hello! You taste like chicken. Gooey, salty chicken!

Mmmh.
